Henry Williams Baker: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Henry Williams Baker (1821–1877) · Hymn writer, translator and composer

26 hymns and 3 hymn tunes on NoteFusion credit Henry Williams Baker. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.
